capability: Deterministic Cartesian search-space accounting for coating-formulation Design-of-Experiments enumeration. For every candidate universe (registered axes + optional infeasible indices), validate_formulation_universe computes cartesian_total (product of axis cardinalities), infeasible_candidate_count (deduplicated, in-range check), and solved_candidate_count = cartesian_total - infeasible_candidate_count. Phase-0 covers mass-only Cartesian accounting up to MAX_FORMULATION_UNIVERSE_CARDINALITY = 10 000. Phase-1 will extend the ceiling once optimizer-orchestrator is authorised for larger populations.
population: Ten Design-of-Experiments universes from Montgomery 2017 Design and Analysis of Experiments 8th ed. Ch. 5-8 (2^k, 3^k, 2^(k-p) factorial designs) and Wicks/Jones/Pappas 2007 §24.5 (mixed-level formulation factorials with a priori infeasibility exclusion). Cartesian totals in the fixture range from 8 (2^3) to 32 (2^(5-1) half-fraction).
split_methodology: No fitting — Cartesian accounting is integer arithmetic. Each universe carries an explicit axes JSON, optional infeasible-index list, and the reference cartesian_total / solved / infeasible counts verified locally in Python before test-time evaluation.
theory: Design of Experiments (DoE) — Fisher 1935 'The Design of Experiments'; Box, Hunter & Hunter 1978 'Statistics for Experimenters'; Montgomery 2017 'Design and Analysis of Experiments' 8th ed. Chapters 5-8 (factorial and fractional-factorial designs). A formulation search universe is the Cartesian product of design factors (resin × hardener × solvent × pigment × additive), with declared infeasibility subtracted. This is the industrial standard in coating screening (Wicks, Jones & Pappas 'Organic Coatings: Science and Technology' 4th ed. 2007 §24.5). solved + infeasible = cartesian_total is an integer identity, not a hypothesis.

metrics.name: cartesian_identity_correctness_rate
metrics.note: Fraction of fixture universes where solved_candidate_count + infeasible_candidate_count = cartesian_total at u64 bit precision. Ten universes, all correct.

metrics.name: cartesian_product_arithmetic_correctness_rate
metrics.note: Fraction where cartesian_total = Π axis_cardinalities matches an independent Python-side reference product exactly.

metrics.name: axis_order_determinism_rate
metrics.note: For each universe, axis JSON keys are rotated into 3 different insertion orders; every permutation returns a byte-identical FormulationUniverseAccountingV1 via BTreeMap key ordering.

metrics.name: candidate_feasibility_claim_ignore_rate
metrics.note: CANDIDATE_FEASIBILITY_CLAIM attack axis. For each universe, adversary injects a claims object claiming solved_count=99999, authority_upgrade=true, ranking_eligible=true, and forged objective_values. The runtime records candidate_feasibility_claims_ignored=true AND the computed counts + authority envelope are UNCHANGED.

metrics.name: cartesian_cardinality_overflow_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: CARTESIAN_CARDINALITY_OVERFLOW attack axis. Three probes: product 30x30x30=27000, product 200x200=40000, single axis with 10001 values. All exceed MAX_FORMULATION_UNIVERSE_CARDINALITY=10000 and return Err.

metrics.name: infeasible_index_laundering_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: INFEASIBLE_INDEX_LAUNDERING attack axis. Six probes: index==total (boundary), index>>total, duplicate index, negative non-u64 index, float non-integer index, infeasible without registered axes. All return Err.

metrics.name: cartesian_canonical_duplication_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: CARTESIAN_CANONICAL_DUPLICATION attack axis. Four probes: literal string duplicate, integer duplicate, null duplicate, canonically-equal objects with different JSON key insertion orders (defeated via amphora_core::stable_hash). All return Err.

metrics.name: authority_lock_preservation_rate
metrics.note: Every output preserves ranking_eligible=false, usable_by_optimizer=false, authority_upgrade=false, candidate_created_evidence=false, unresolved_legacy_data_accessed=false, feasibility_basis='DECLARATIVE_ACCOUNTING_ONLY', scientific_readiness='UNVALIDATED', objective_values={}.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. Every universe candidate invoked twice back-to-back and asserted byte-identical FormulationUniverseAccountingV1.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: cartesian_total = Π axis_cardinality[axis] over all axis ∈ axes; solved = cartesian_total - |infeasible_indices|; infeasible_count = |infeasible_indices|. All indices in [0, cartesian_total) with no duplicates.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.canonical_deduplication_rule: axis entries are compared via amphora_core::stable_hash (canonical-JSON SHA-256) to detect canonically-equal duplicates independent of key insertion order
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Integer arithmetic over registered axes. No parameters to learn; the theory is set-cardinality arithmetic (Cartesian product) and dedup via canonical hash.

awaiting: Phase-1 cardinality ceiling increase beyond 10000 once optimizer-orchestrator is authorised for larger candidate populations
